data.one_liner: Native Liquid Glass widgets for iOS and macOS using platform views.
data.what_it_does: Hosts real UIKit/AppKit controls inside Flutter using Platform Views and method channels to deliver native Liquid Glass widgets with pixel-perfect fidelity.
use_when: You want native iOS and macOS Liquid Glass widgets inside a Flutter app.
You are building a proof-of-concept or experimental app utilizing Apple's modern native styles.
avoid_when: You need a production-ready, fully tested widget library for macOS.
You require robust non-Apple platform support beyond basic fallbacks.
strengths: Provides pixel-perfect native UIKit/AppKit controls via platform views.
Includes a set of ready-to-use widgets like sliders, switches, buttons, and tab bars.
weaknesses: Experimental proof of concept with limited platform coverage on macOS.
Requires specific beta Xcode versions to build.
data.setup_notes: Requires iOS 14.0+, macOS 11.0+, and installing the Xcode beta using xcode-select.
